instruction.en: Press and hold the test button for about 5 seconds until the indicator blinks.
instruction.fr: Maintenez le bouton de test environ 5 secondes jusqu’à ce que le voyant clignote.
instruction.nl: Houd de testknop ongeveer 5 seconden ingedrukt tot het lampje knippert.
instruction.de: Halten Sie die Testtaste etwa 5 Sekunden gedrückt, bis die Anzeige blinkt.

metadata.source: zigbee-herdsman-converters tuya.ts TS0601_smoke_4 (_TZE200_yh7aoahi, t5p1vj8r, uebojraa, vzekyi4c, dq1mfjug) and TS0601_smoke_1 (_TZE204_ntcy3xu1): DP1 smoke (raw 0 = smoke), DP4 tamper (smoke_1 only), DP14 battery state / battery low (0 = low), DP15 battery % (smoke_4 only). TS0601 only; the TS0205 couple on smoke_sensor3 is left in place. Reimplemented and credited (P3039), no upstream code copied.
